title: Apple's 1st foldable phone launched: Specifications, features & price in India of iPhone Duo
content: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable phone, at Rs 2,99,900 in India. It opens to a 7.6-inch display with a 5.4-inch screen outside, runs the A20 Pro chip, and carries a battery on each side for up to 24 hours of use. Touch ID replaces Face ID, and the phone is eSIM-only. Pre-orders open on October 16, with sales from October 23.

title: Pegula vs Navarro: The $15 billion 'battle' that dwarfed Djokovic, Federer and Nadal's wealth

Securing victory, Pegula progresses to the semi-finals for the third consecutive year, showcasing her resilience on the court. Meanwhile, Navarro's impressive journey to the quarter-finals hints at a bright future in tennis, with both athletes coming from families boasting a combined net worth of fifteen billion dollars.

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max launched: Price in India and all details

Pre-orders kick off on September 12, with global availability beginning on September 18. In India, the Pro model will start at Rs 1,64,900.

title: 1980s AI photo trend: 11 ChatGPT prompts to turn photos into retro Bollywood looks

Users should check AI creations before sharing them online.

title: PM aide: E20 cap likely for existing vehicles
content: India is set to surpass its E20 ethanol blending goal, with plans for the introduction of flex-fuel vehicles that will support higher blends. This initiative aims to decrease dependency on imported crude oil, while the government investigates the potential of biofuels in diesel engines. Moreover, ethanol producers are urged to look into compressed biogas and enhanced product offerings for a sustainable future.

title: 60,000 trees later, lost English woodland is returning with more bird species
content: A transformative upland restoration initiative in Cumbria has brought new life to a sheep-grazed fell, with native trees being planted to stimulate the recovery of dormant seed banks and form enchanting ghost woodlands. This environmental project has witnessed the arrival of eleven new breeding bird species since 2016. Additionally, it enhances natural flood management and boosts local farming incomes through sustainable environmental agreements supporting upland livestock.

title: Apple increases prices of iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air & iPhone 16

The iPhone 17 now retails for Rs 99,900, marked up by Rs 17,000, whereas the premium iPhone Air skyrocketed by Rs 30,000. Highlights of the new iPhone 17 encompass a 120Hz display and upgraded 48MP cameras.

title: Antarctica gained record 695 billion tons of ice after decades of loss
content: Between 2021 and 2023, Antarctica experienced a notable gain in ice mass, primarily driven by exceptional snowfall in East Antarctica. This unusual occurrence, influenced by warmer tropical ocean temperatures, caused atmospheric disturbances that transported moisture southward. Although this gain temporarily countered ongoing ice loss in other regions, it does not signify a change in Antarctica's long-term trend of declining ice mass.

title: Tiger Woods and Vanessa Trump’s wealth: How did they build their business empires?

Woods' TGR Ventures oversees golf course design and sports entertainment projects. His portfolio includes fashion, hospitality, and technology investments. Both individuals have significant real estate assets contributing to their financial standing.

title: Stephen and Ayesha Curry’s parenting: How did they teach kids to handle criticism?

Ayesha spoke out to protect Riley's experiences with early fame, while also addressing unwanted comments about Canon's weight. Their mission is clear: to empower their children to wear the Curry name proudly and securely.

title: 3 trucks of debris, 1 missing wall: How renovation doomed Delhi PG building

A labour contractor was arrested and stated Mahesh Gupta paid him daily for the work.  The building's paying guest operator was also arrested for negligence.  Seven people died after the five-storey building collapsed on September 6.

title: Over 10 feared trapped as under-construction building collapses in Gandhinagar

This incident follows a recent building collapse in Delhi which tragically killed seven people. Authorities are continuing their rescue efforts in Gandhinagar while awaiting further details. The event has renewed scrutiny of building safety and construction practices nationwide.

title: Wall Street falls as crude tops $101; Dow tumbles over 300 points

This increase has amplified worries over fuel costs and inflation for both consumers and businesses alike. With petrol prices showing a 32% increase compared to last year, household finances are feeling the strain.

title: He scored 99th percentile in CAT but chose Army; meet Col Anurag Upadhyay
content: Colonel Anurag Upadhyay, a former Indian Army Special Forces officer, is seeking expert medical and technological support after suffering a severe stroke in August 2025 that resulted in locked-in syndrome and bilateral below-knee amputations. Despite remaining conscious and communicating through eye movements, his family is exploring advanced rehabilitation, neurological research and assistive technologies such as brain-computer interfaces and eye-tracking systems. A public appeal seeks credible specialists, institutions and organisations that could help identify further possibilities for recovery and independence.

title: ‘Wanted to teach him lesson’: Delhi accused on assault that killed Manipuri musician

Singh, a musician, died hours after the assault due to internal injuries.  Police are investigating all aspects, including a potential racial angle in the incident.  The North Eastern Students' Organisation demanded a swift and impartial probe into the matter.

title: Watch: Ferry erupts in flames off Philippines’ Palawan; 5 killed

The Philippine Coast Guard swiftly initiated rescue missions, successfully saving 42 individuals from the inferno. The ill-fated ferry had embarked on its journey from Manila, carrying numerous passengers and crew members.

title: Jeremy Corbyn finds buyer for £700,000 London home after 19 years

The former Labour leader bought the North London property for £363,000 in 2007 and initially listed it for £800,000 this year. The house was later reduced to offers over £700,000 and is now under offer, according to reports.

title: BJP to celebrate PM birthday, 25 yrs as head of govt
content:
NEW DELHI: BJP president Nitin Nabin Wednesday unveiled a month-long calendar of his party's programmes to mark PM Narendra Modi's birthday coupled with the upcoming milestone of his unbroken stint of 25 years as head of govt, with youth at the centre of several events. Sharing details of "Seva Sankalp Abhiyaan", which will start on Modi's 76th birthday on Sept 17, Nabin was dismissive of Rahul Gandhi's Gen Z-centric outreach. "The youth is fully behind Modi," he said. Citing govt programmes like Khelo India, Fit India and Start-Up India among others, he retorted, "Where was Rahul Gandhi then?"

content:
NEW DELHI: The complainant who had filed a criminal defamation case against leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi for his claim of Chinese incursions into Indian territory Wednesday complained to SC that the registry is not listing the appeal for hearing, apparently because of the personality involved. Appearing for Uttar Pradesh govt, senior advocate Gaurav Bhatia said SC had stayed the proceedings in the criminal defamation case against Rahul on Aug 4 last year and despite a specific date being given by the court for hearing Rahul's appeal, the SC registry has not listed the matter. Rahul's counsel S Prasanna objected to Bhatia's contention and requested the court to not take cognisance of it. The CJI Surya Kant led bench told Bhatia to make an application seeking early hearing of the appeal so that the mattercould be posted for hearing. TNN

End of Article

title: Goods train derails in J&K’s Kathua, no injury or damages
content:
Kathua, J&K (ANI photo)

JAMMU: A goods train derailed at Chann Aroria railway station in J&K’s Kathua district on Wednesday morning. Officials said no one was hurt and no damage was incurred in the incident. The derailment occurred around 9.30am when the goods train was heading back after unloading cement, and one of its coaches went off the track in the station’s yard, officials said. A technical team from Kathua rushed to the spot and brought the derailed coach back on track after two hours of efforts. Earlier on July 10, two bogies of a goods train moving from Jammu to Punjab derailed near Lakhanpur in Kathua after debris fell on the tracks following a rain-triggered landslide.

End of Article

title: Cyber fraud worth 5,044 crore prevented: Govt
content:
NEW DELHI: India is increasingly stopping cyber fraud before money leaves a victim's account. A telecom-led risk system has helped banks and payment platforms prevent suspected fraudulent transactions worth Rs 5,043.7 crore in 15 months, govt said, marking a shift from tracing stolen money to intercepting payments in real time, reports Aabhas Sharma. The Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI), launched by the department of telecommunications in May 2025, assigns mobile numbers medium, high or very high risk ratings. The alerts are fed directly to banks and UPI platforms, allowing them to warn customers or block risky payments. Experts said the system's biggest achievement was making fraud operations costlier. However, fraudsters could turn to SIMs obtained through fraudulent KYC or virtual numbers. An expert said criminals could also evade mobile-number risk scores by obtaining fresh or "aged" SIM cards.

End of Article
